item.title: BayLing-Duplex: Native Full-Duplex Speech Dialogue with a Single Autoregressive LLM
item.description: Real-time, full-duplex speech interaction is a key feature of next-generation spoken chatbots, allowing the model to listen and speak at the same time and to handle natural phenomena such as overlap, hesitation, and barge-in. Existing speech language models (SpeechLMs) such as LLaMA-Omni and GLM-4-V

item.description: Recent full-duplex spoken dialogue models have demonstrated compelling progress toward human-like interaction, enabling agents to respond with low latency, produce backchannels, and handle user barge-ins. item.title: Multi-Faceted Interactivity Alignment in Full-Duplex Speech Models
item.description: Full-duplex spoken dialogue models can listen and speak simultaneously, making them a promising architecture for natural conversation. However, current models are trained solely with supervised learning through token-level likelihood maximization, which does not directly optimize interaction-level b

item.description: Most end-to-end (E2E) spoken dialogue systems (SDS) rely on voice activity detection (VAD) for turn-taking, but VAD fails to distinguish between pauses and turn completions. Duplex SDS models address this by predicting output continuously, including silence tokens, thus removing the need for explici

item.title: Chronological Thinking in Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Language Models
item.description: Recent advances in spoken dialogue language models (SDLMs) reflect growing interest in shifting from turn-based to full-duplex systems, where the models continuously perceive user speech streams while generating responses. This simultaneous listening and speaking design enables real-time interaction

item.title: A Reliability Assessment of LALM Audio Judges for Full-Duplex Voice Agents
item.description: We report the empirical reliability of Gemini models as audio judges that score full-duplex agent conversations directly from the raw stereo waveform, tested across three models in the Gemini family: 2.5 Flash, 3.5 Flash, and 3.1 Pro. Our primary evidence base uses Gemini 2.5 Flash as the ground-tru

item.title: Phoenix-VAD: Streaming Semantic Endpoint Detection for Full-Duplex Speech Interaction
item.description: Phoenix-VAD 是一个基于 LLM 的流式语义端点检测模型，为全双工语音交互提供即插即用的“用户是否说完”判定模块。对本站的座舱助手直接有用：harness 里边说边听时最痛的难点就是语义级 endpoint/抢话判定，可以借鉴其把 LLM 语义理解能力用于流式 VAD 的思路，替代纯声学 VAD。

item.title: TurnGuide: Enhancing Meaningful Full Duplex Spoken Interactions via Dynamic Turn-Level Text-Speech Interleaving
item.description: TurnGuide 针对全双工语音语言模型提出动态的轮次级文本-语音交错生成机制，让模型在边听边说中产出更有意义的轮替行为（覆盖打断、附和、重叠语音等场景）。对自研 harness 的启示在于：可以用文本侧的轮次信号来引导语音流的生成与打断管理，而不是完全依赖端到端双声道数据训练。

item.title: DuplexChat: Constructing Speaker-Separated Full-Duplex Dialogue Speech at Scale for Spoken Dialogue Language Modeling
item.description: DuplexChat 是一个开源的全双工对话语料及构建管线 DuplexChat-Pipe，能把现有单声道语音语料转换成分说话人双流的全双工对话数据，解决 SDLM 训练数据稀缺问题。如果要在 Qwen3-Omni 之上微调出全双工能力而非纯外挂 harness，这条数据管线可以直接借鉴来低成本造训练语料。

item.title: Integrating Facial Generation into Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Systems
item.description: Moshi-Face 是首个把面部生成纳入全双工对话的模型，在 Moshi 基础上同时处理用户的音频+面部输入，并同步生成语音与面部动作。对本站“视觉+语音座舱助手”的主题很对口：座舱里本就有舱内摄像头，可借鉴其把视觉流与音频流并列送入全双工回路的架构思路。

item.title: DuplexSLA: A Full-Duplex Spoken Language Model with Synchronized Speech, Language, and Action
item.description: DuplexSLA 提出语音、语言、动作三者同步的全双工口语模型，在双工主干内原生开辟了一条用于对话中规划和工具调用的通道，使 agentic 行为不再被绑在轮次边界或外部级联上。这正是本站“晚注入工具清单”痛点的正面回应：可借鉴其在流式生成中途插入工具调用而不打断听说的设计。

item.title: SoulX-Duplug: Plug-and-Play Streaming State Prediction Module for Realtime Full-Duplex Speech Conversation
item.description: SoulX-Duplug 是一个即插即用的流式状态预测模块，为现有语音对话系统补齐全双工能力，同时规避了训练数据难获取、灾难性遗忘和可扩展性差的问题。其“不重训主干、外挂模块实现双工”的路线与本站自研 harness 的哲学高度一致，值得重点跟进。

item.title: Why is nobody using this? Full-duplex voice streaming with Gemini Live in React
item.description: 这是一篇工程向分享：作者封装了调用 Gemini Live API 的 React hook，实现可打断的全双工语音对话，并吐槽浏览器侧音频工程之坑（48kHz 重采样到 16kHz 入/24kHz 出、内置 VAD、屏幕共享、工具调用）。对本站座舱 harness 的客户端/音频链路有直接参考价值，尤其是重采样与打断处理的实战细节。

item.title: Enabling Conversational Behavior Reasoning Capabilities in Full-Duplex Speech
item.description: 该工作提出一个用 Graph-of-Thoughts 把人类对话中“意图到行为”的因果链显式建模的框架，让全双工语音系统能对何时说话、何时附和等会话行为做推理。对 harness 层的启示是：轮替决策可以不只依赖端到端信号，而用一个可解释的推理结构来决定开口/闭嘴/插话时机。

item.title: SuperdeMan/cockpit-agent
item.description: 一个面向智能座舱的云边协同 AI Agent 开源项目：端侧负责毫秒级车控，云端做声明式 Multi-Agent 与 Skill/DAG 编排，支持 S2S 实时语音、声纹多用户、视觉与 HMI。其'LLM 只管理解与规划、VAL 负责确定性安全执行'的分层思路，与本站 harness 的架构理念高度同构，可作为座舱语音助手工程化（尤其车控安全边界与云边分工）的直接参照。

item.title: TurnNat: Automatic Evaluation of Turn-Taking Naturalness in Dyadic Spoken Dialogue
item.description: TurnNat 提出一个基于似然（likelihood）的框架，用于自动评估双通道口语对话中轮换（turn-taking）的自然度，把原本依赖人工判断或单一计时指标的异质时序失败统一到一个可比较的体系里。对本站的全双工座舱助手而言，它补上了'边说边听'体验难量化的一环，可用来自动评测抢话、响应延迟、打断时机等关键指标。

item.title: How Should LLMs Listen While Speaking? A Study of User-Stream Routing in Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue
item.description: 这篇论文系统研究全双工口语对话中的核心架构问题：当 LLM 正在生成回复时，用户音频流应以何种方式路由进模型（因为 LLM 天然只支持延续单一线索序列）。它直指本站'边说边听、流式进 KV'的技术要害，其关于用户流注入位置的对比分析可直接指导自研 harness 中晚注入/中断处理的设计取舍。

item.title: EchoChain: A Full-Duplex Benchmark for State-Update Reasoning Under Interruptions
item.description: EchoChain 是一个受控基准，专门评估全双工语音助手在用户中途打断后能否正确更新任务状态并继续对话，并归纳出打断后续回复中的三类典型失败模式。它命中现有轮次式评测覆盖不到的盲区，可作为本站座舱助手打断恢复（barge-in 后状态修正）能力的回归测试与选型依据。

item.title: LMPAN: A Lightweight Multi-Path Alignment Network for Joint Full-Duplex Acoustic Echo Cancellation and Noise Suppression
item.description: We propose a lightweight multi-path alignment network (LMPAN) for on-device joint acoustic echo cancellation (AEC) and noise suppression (NS) in full-duplex spoken dialogue systems. item.description: More than a dozen spoken dialogue systems have recently claimed to be "full-duplex," yet the term has been used to describe substantially different capabilities. item.description: Real-time spoken dialogue systems face a fundamental tension between latency and response quality. item.description: Empathetic spoken dialogue systems must infer a user's emotional state to respond appropriately, yet everyday speech often carries weak, neutral, or ambiguous affective cues. item.description: We present DyaPlex, a streaming, full-duplex speech-and-motion model designed for dyadic interaction. item.description: We introduce OmniInteract, a streaming benchmark for real-time omnimodal large language models evaluated through native online inference over audio-visual streams. item.description: Human conversation is organized by an implicit chain of thought and manifests as temporally structured conversational behaviors.
